Anthropic 将 Claude Sonnet 5.5 缓存读取价格减半至每百万 token $0.10 / One more thing: we’re halving the price of cache reads on Claude Sonnet 5.5, to $0.10 per million tokens. That makes Sonnet 5.5 around 20% cheaper to run on most long-running work.

summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布将 Claude Sonnet 5.5 的缓存读取价格减半，降至每百万 token $0.10。官方称这使 Sonnet 5.5 在多数长期运行任务上的运行成本降低约 20%。
